title: An AI label on Leavitt's exit post is fueling the AI watermark debate
excerpt: User on X are quick to spot a "made with AI" label on the former press secretary's goodbye post, fueling the debate over AI watermarking practices.
content_html:
Karoline Leavitt's goodbye to the White House came with an unexpected disclosure.

The outgoing White House press secretary announced Wednesday that she would leave her role at the end of August after struggling to balance the job's demands with raising two young children.

"The truth is since returning to the White House after the birth of my daughter, I have felt in my heart that I cannot be the best mom my two young children deserve while devoting the constant time, energy, and attention required of the White House Press Secretary," Leavitt wrote in a lengthy post on X.

At the bottom of the post, however, X displayed a "Made with AI" label, a detail that users across social media platforms quickly spotted and called out.

As of around 8 p.m. Eastern, the AI label on Leavitt's post had disappeared. X and the White House did not respond to requests for comment.

Below is a screenshot of how the bottom of Leavitt's post looked with the AI label before it vanished.

It was not immediately clear what triggered the addition of the label to Leavitt's post, which also included two photographs.

The label does not necessarily mean AI wrote Leavitt's statement. According to X's official guidelines, the platform uses the "Made with AI" label on any media it determines to be AI-generated or manipulated.

Trump said in a post on X that Leavitt was departing "so she can spend more time with her beautiful young children and family," adding that she would become one of his top outside advisors.

Leavitt, 28, became the youngest White House press secretary when Trump returned to office in 2025. Trump has yet to announce her replacement.

Companies are making it increasingly difficult to pass off AI-generated content as entirely human-made. In July, YouTube said it would be demonetizing mass-produced generic content and AI personas designed to game the platform. Substack and Pinterest have also launched tools intended to help readers identify AI-generated content.

Anthropic said this week that new Claude models will weave an "imperceptible watermark" into generated text. The signal can survive copying, pasting, and some editing, though extensive rewriting, translation, or combining the output with other text could remove it, the company said.

Anthropic cautioned that its watermark would not prove Claude wrote an entire document, and that using the chatbot to proofread or translate human writing could also leave a detectable mark.

Business Insider's Katie Notopoulos wrote on Tuesday that the watermark could complicate life for people reluctant to acknowledge that they're using AI, from students submitting assignments to authors and professionals publishing polished posts under their own names.

"Once AI detectors or watermarks are more ingrained in popular products, does it become more or less embarrassing to be caught using AI to write?" Notopoulos wrote. "I'm not really sure where the evolving norms around AI writing will land."

content_html_zh:
卡罗琳·莱维特告别白宫之际，还透露了一个意想不到的消息。

这位即将卸任的白宫新闻秘书周三宣布，在努力平衡工作要求和抚养两个年幼的孩子之后，她将于八月底离职。

“事实是，自从我女儿出生后回到白宫后，我内心感到，在投入白宫新闻秘书所需的持续时间、精力和注意力的同时，我无法成为我的两个年幼的孩子应得的最好的妈妈，”莱维特在 X 上的一篇长文中写道。

然而，在帖子的底部，X 显示了“人工智能制造”的标签，这一细节很快就被社交媒体平台上的用户发现并呼吁。

截至晚上 8 点左右 东部，莱维特帖子上的人工智能标签消失了。 X 和白宫没有回应置评请求。

下面是莱维特帖子底部带有 AI 标签的屏幕截图，然后该标签消失了。

目前尚不清楚是什么触发了莱维特帖子中添加该标签的原因，其中还包括两张照片。

该标签并不一定意味着人工智能撰写了莱维特的声明。 根据 X 的官方指导方针，该平台在其确定由人工智能生成或操纵的任何媒体上使用“人工智能制造”标签。

特朗普在 X 上的一篇帖子中表示，莱维特即将离开，“这样她就可以花更多的时间陪伴她美丽的孩子和家人”，并补充说她将成为他的高级外部顾问之一。

28 岁的莱维特在特朗普 2025 年重返白宫时成为最年轻的白宫新闻秘书。 特朗普尚未宣布她的继任者。

公司越来越难以将人工智能生成的内容冒充为完全人造的内容。 今年 7 月，YouTube 表示将取消大规模生产的通用内容和旨在博弈该平台的人工智能角色的货币化。 Substack 和 Pinterest 还推出了旨在帮助读者识别人工智能生成内容的工具。

Anthropic 本周表示，新的 Claude 模型将在生成的文本中编织“难以察觉的水印”。 该公司表示，该信号可以在复制、粘贴和一些编辑后幸存下来，但大量重写、翻译或将输出与其他文本组合可能会将其删除。

Anthropic 警告说，它的水印并不能证明克劳德写了整个文档，而且使用聊天机器人校对或翻译人类书写也可能留下可检测的标记。

《商业内幕》的凯蒂·诺托普洛斯周二写道，对于那些不愿承认自己正在使用人工智能的人来说，水印可能会让生活变得复杂，从提交作业的学生到以自己名义发表精美帖子的作者和专业人士。

“一旦人工智能检测器或水印在流行产品中更加根深蒂固，使用人工智能写作被抓到会变得或多或少变得尴尬吗？” 诺托普洛斯写道。 “我不太确定围绕人工智能写作不断发展的规范将落在哪里。”
